sections.title: Slack network sponsorship
sections.content: Write the Docs is a community focused on all things related to software documentation. Our Slack network is the beating heart of our community, where thousands of documentarians hang out regularly to chat. Sponsorship of our Slack network does two things: It allows us to cover the cost of moderating and managing our Slack community It allows you to get your name and message in front of our audience of Documentarians Buy a Slack sponsorship — $350 You can join our Slack and read some of the messages to get a feel for the community.

sections.title: Audience
sections.content: Our audience is made up of technical writers and decision makers in the software documentation industry. The current Slack stats are: 27,000users 100+channels The best idea of who is in our Slack is the information we have from our conferences. Our audience is made up of: Writers and editors 64% Documentation managers 15% Programmers and developer relations 7% Product and project managers 4% Everything else 10% Roughly 1 in 5 holds a manager-level role, and 79% write or manage documentation. These figures come from the 566 registration survey responses at Write the Docs Portland 2026.

sections.title: Sponsored entry format
sections.content: Sponsor copy will be posted to the #announcements channel in Slack, which is joined by every user in our Slack. It’s used for community-wide announcements, so your message will be very visible in the community. The current format is: Up to 2 paragraphs of copy Up to 1 link in that copy - we generally recommend inline links, so that some of your text is linked, and the links will be expanded in Slack.

sections.title: Content guidance
sections.content: The provided copy must respect our general Slack Rules and Code of Conduct. With regards to the No Sales-Y Content rule, sponsored posts have an exemption to the No Direct Pitches, No links without context, and No Brands subrules. We would still ask that you review the Be Transparent rule, as it is likely to improve the community reception of your copy. Write the Docs reserves the right to request changes to or reject copy that violates the Slack Rules or Code of Conduct.

sections.title: Schedule
sections.content: We currently allow 1 sponsored post per month on our Slack. We aim to send these during the first week of the month, but can be flexible if we haven’t sold our current month.

sections.title: Pricing
sections.content: The price for reaching our audience is $350 per month. You can pay via our online payment form, or we can issue you an invoice.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: Email us at sponsorship@writethedocs.org to purchase a Slack sponsorship. Buy a Slack sponsorship — $350
